# Phase 24 — Requirements Elicitation (read-only)

Use the requirements-engineer agent and requirements-elicitation skill. Inspect approved discovery notes. Identify users, JTBD, workflows, permissions, constraints, non-goals and open questions. Do not edit application code. Produce an elicitation log with confirmed/assumed/proposed/unresolved labels. Ask only high-impact unanswered questions; do not invent stakeholder answers. Report gate `NEEDS APPROVAL` until the user validates the elicitation.
